schema_note: Ruleset consumed by le_calc.damage / cooldown / simulate. Every tunable value carries an evidence status. status vocabulary: confirmed (game data or user-confirmed), derived (arithmetic over confirmed inputs), assumed (explicit v1 assumption, needs review), unresolved (unknown, must not be silently defaulted). This file is the authoritative source for Black Hole skill-tree modifiers; player-side sources come from the input snapshot.
